description: This file defines the interface for the LVREV module, including types, structures, constants, and function prototypes related to reverb processing in an audio framework.

methods.name: LVREV_GetMemoryTable
methods.description: Obtains memory requirements or base addresses for the LVREV module, depending on the handle provided.

methods.name: LVREV_GetInstanceHandle
methods.description: Creates a new LVREV module instance and returns its handle.

methods.name: LVREV_GetControlParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current control parameters of a LVREV instance.

methods.name: LVREV_SetControlParameters
methods.description: Sets or updates control parameters for a LVREV instance.

methods.name: LVREV_ClearAudioBuffers
methods.description: Clears internal audio buffers of the LVREV module.

methods.name: LVREV_Process
methods.description: Processes input audio data through the LVREV reverb effect.
